messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary v5.3.0 regression: p95 latency +60% on 'chat-multiregion' route. Autorevert scheduled in 2m. details: https://telemetry/5.3.0
samir: Oof. This is big. Is it uniform or model-variant specific?
helen: Checking traces now. Looks like only requests hitting the new quantized model variant qv2 are affected. non-qv2 traffic fine.
tori: If it's variant-level, I'd prefer to reroute that variant to a smaller model fallback (v5.2.x standard) instead of full-service revert. Less churn for other slices.
ben: Oncall. Agreed we can try a hybrid: let autorevert run for the overall rollout but also apply an immediate variant-fallback rule for live requests to qv2 to minimize user impact. Who can push the fallback?
samir: I can push a variant routing rule. Command: ```bash
rls variant-fallback --env canary --variant qv2 --to standard --reason "qv2 p95 regression"
```
ops-bot: Autorevert countdown: 120s. Operator override can suppress but none requested.
samir: Executing variant-fallback now.
ops-bot: Executing: rls variant-fallback --env canary --variant qv2 --to standard
ops-bot: SUCCESS: qv2 variant traffic rerouted to standard model.
helen: After reroute, p95 on chat-multiregion dropped ~45% and overall errors stable. Looks effective.
tori: Good. Since we didn't suppress autorevert, deploy-bot will still run autorevert if conditions persist. That gives us two safety nets: immediate variant fallback + automated global revert if needed.
ben: I'll prepare a terse CS note: "We detected degraded response times on a new quantized model variant during canary. We routed traffic to the previous model variant while we investigate. No data exposure. Updates in 30m."
samir: Filing postmortem ticket RL-9997 and attaching variant traces + quantization PR.
helen: Next steps: validate qv2 build flags and kernel optimizations, iterate on quantization config, and re-run canary once patched.
ops-bot: Autorevert: no further action taken; timer expired without triggering because variant fallback remedied metric.
ben: Closing: hybrid mitigation worked (variant-fallback + autorevert safety). CS notified, RCA ticket filed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
